items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: When I was getting ready, I left Abernathy and I was getting ready to come east.

ctx.x: Well, when did you work for him?

When I was getting ready, I left Abernathy and I was getting ready to come east. I had a telegram from Burke Bailey, it must have been, to come to join a walk-a-thon -- they had a thing called a walk-a-thon in those days. And they wanted me to (..?)
